title: Implement OpenAI provider with Costs API
description: Create app/providers/openai.py implementing BalanceProvider. Use /v1/organization/costs endpoint (Admin API Key) to get total_costs. Calculate balance = total_deposits - total_costs. Analyze 30-day spend trend to predict days_until_empty. Return alert_recharge_soon if < 3 days.

title: Implement base provider interface
description: Create app/providers/base.py with BalanceProvider abstract base class using Python ABC. Define methods: provider_name, display_name, get_balance(api_key), validate_api_key_format(api_key).

title: Create deposits JSON schema and exception hierarchy
description: Create app/providers/exceptions.py with ProviderError, ProviderAuthenticationError, ProviderRateLimitError, ProviderUnavailableError. Create deposits/deposits.json schema and loader for OpenAI manual balance tracking.

title: Setup project structure and dependencies
description: Create directory structure (app/, app/api/, app/providers/, tests/), create requirements.txt with FastAPI, httpx, uvicorn, pydantic. Create .env.example file.

title: Create FastAPI application entry point
description: Create app/main.py with FastAPI app initialization. Call ProviderRegistry.discover_providers() on startup. Include CORS middleware. Add /health endpoint. Include routers from api/routes.py.

title: Create API models and response schemas
description: Create app/api/models.py with Pydantic models: BalanceResponse, ErrorResponse, ProviderListResponse. Include fields: provider, balance, currency, projected_days_remaining, avg_daily_spend, alert_recharge_soon.

title: Implement provider registry with auto-discovery
description: Create app/providers/__init__.py with ProviderRegistry class. Implement register(), get_provider(), list_providers(), discover_providers() methods for automatic provider discovery.

title: Write unit tests for providers and API
description: Create tests/test_providers/test_openai.py with mocked httpx responses. Create tests/test_api.py for API endpoints. Create conftest.py with test fixtures. Minimum 80% coverage.

title: Write documentation and README
description: Update README.md with API usage examples, deployment instructions, and deposits.json format. Add .env.example with required variables. Create Dockerfile for container deployment.

title: Implement FastAPI routes and endpoints
description: Create app/api/routes.py with GET /api/v1/providers (list providers) and GET /api/v1/balance/{provider_name} endpoints. Add X-API-Key header authentication. Map provider exceptions to HTTP status codes (401, 500).
